query:
SELECT NOT (
                 EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM entitlement_grant g WHERE g.org_id = $1)
                 AND NOT EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1 FROM entitlement_grant g
                   WHERE g.org_id = $1 AND g.revoked_at IS NULL
                     AND (g.expires_at IS NULL OR g.expires_at > now())
                 )
               ) AS "stands!"
